original.target_description: Original Smith-case preliminary experiment (study 1), C1 thief killing officer versus C2 innocent driver killing car thief; between-condition chi-square comparison of whether the actor intentionally brought about the death; 126 undergraduate participants.

n.sample_role: Undergraduate participants included in the reported two-condition chi-square test (analytic N explicitly printed in test).
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported for this experiment; test N equals the reported participant total.
n.location: Author manuscript p. 14 (PDF page 14), C1 versus C2 results; participant description p. 13.

es.location: Author manuscript p. 14 (PDF page 14), C1 versus C2 intentionally comparison.

p.location: Author manuscript p. 14 (PDF page 14), same C1 versus C2 intentionally chi-square test.

notes: Original-only blind validation. Evidence is the 31-page Yale-hosted author manuscript, not the 17-page published article; manuscript pagination retained without assuming final-version equivalence. Supplied published/manuscript locator does not map directly to this version; the matching original experiment and outcome are identified on manuscript pp. 13–15, with the target test on p. 14. Rendered PDF p. 14 confirms chi-square, df=1, analytic N and p bound. Canonical text renders the superscript chi-square as χ2; quotations preserve canonical glyphs and line breaks. No metric conversion. Replication and success narrative are unassigned placeholders.
